# Google Material Icons

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons

Outlined 24px icons, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). SVG paths are embedded in src/components/MaterialIcon.vue with application color and dimensions.

- dashboard: src/action/dashboard/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- calendar: src/notification/event_note/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- history: src/action/history/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- folder: src/file/folder_open/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- assignment: src/action/assignment/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- qr: src/communication/qr_code_scanner/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- settings: src/action/settings/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- lock: src/action/lock/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
- logs: src/action/subject/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg
